name: Geotechnical Engineering - I
description: Origin and Classification of Geomaterials, Soils; Phase Relationships; Effective Stress Principle; effective Stress under Hydrostatic and 1D flow; Permeability; Flow Through Soils–Darcy’s Law, Laplace Equation, Flow nets, Seepage; compaction of Soils; Compressibility; Consolidation; Terzaghi’s 1D Consolidation Theory; settlement Analysis; Shear Strength and failure in geomaterials; drainage Conditions; Pore water pressure; Mohr’s Circle; Failure Envelope and Strength Parameters; Factors Affecting Shear Strength; Introduction to behaviour of soils under cyclic loading, Engineering properties of Natural soils, Compacted soils and modified soils and various types of geomaterials; Introduction to field estimation of soil & geomaterials properties; Basic application of soil mechanics and geotechnical engineering concepts to field problems
